  PROBLEM: The isolated temporary prompt tree omits prompts/references/security-money-lens.txt even though the staged prompts reference REFERENCE_SECURITY_MONEY_LENS.
  WHY: Strict reference resolution raises PromptLoadError and causes the CI lint test to fail.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1278-1282 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: ENABLE_SECURITY_PASS_RAW="${ENABLE_SECURITY_PASS:-false}" disables the security gate when ENABLE_SECURITY_PASS is unset despite the documented and workflow default being true.
  WHY: Direct or future wrapper invocations that omit the variable silently take the legacy completion path without security gating; severity was reported as BLOCKER, MAJOR, and HIGH, so the highest severity is used.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14789-14831 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The /re-security-pass reset block passes an empty DEFAULT_BRANCH_TRACKING to ensure_security_pass_before_completion and then suppresses failure with || true.
  WHY: The empty branch produces an invalid git fetch refspec, the re-audit fails closed, and the reset appears successful while re-auditing is deferred or ineffective; severity was reported as BLOCKER and MAJOR, so the highest severity is used.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:975 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The mock_security_audit stub uses json.dumps(json.dumps(security_audit_payload or {})), producing a double-JSON-encoded findings payload instead of a schema-shaped JSON object.
  WHY: jq validation of .schema_version fails and the poller treats the mock engine as unavailable; moonshotai_kimi-k3 disputed this finding as a false positive.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:14236-14242 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: A security-pass-fixing cycle continues without a REST fallback when the batched GraphQL cache does not contain the active fix issue.
  WHY: Persistent cache misses leave the project in security-pass-fixing until the bounded cycle limit triggers terminal failure, with no convergence path.
- prompts/contracts/mode-security-audit.yml:4 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: REFERENCE_SECURITY_MONEY_LENS is allowlisted for mode-security-audit even though the mode prompt does not contain the corresponding placeholder.
  WHY: The unused variable widens the prompt-input surface and forces tests to provide a fabricated value.
- unattended_system_instructions.md:215-223 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3]
  PROBLEM: The Security and money-handling interpretation subsection paraphrases the canonical security-money-lens reference with divergent wording.
  WHY: The duplicate normative guidance can drift and create inconsistent interpretations across interactive and unattended phases.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
